name: Mojo

abilityDetails.Degeneration: Rakibe zamanla doğrudan, engellenemez hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Bonusları degeneration'a çevirirken pasif güç kazanır. Bonus immün veya yüksek yetenek azaltmalı şampiyon kullan. Petrify erişimi olan şampiyon önerilir, onu E1'de tut.
signatureAbility:
Big Mojo Energy
When Mojo activates his Anti-Life Field, if he has at least 5 million Followers, he also gains a Fury Buff for the duration of his Anti-Life Field, increasing Attack Rating by +[10,168 - 20,336].
Additionally, Mojo starts each Quest with 1 million Persistent Subscribers, up to 5 million.
At the beginning of the fight, each Subscriber gives him a Follower. His Followers can never fall below his Subscribers.
When Mojo wins a fight, if he has more Followers than Subscribers, he gains 1 million Subscribers. When Mojo loses a fight, he loses 1 million Subscribers.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Mojo gains 30% less Power from landing Hits.
Physical Resistance decreased by -[485.29].

abilitySections.title: Audience Prompts
content: After the start of the fight, Mojo receives a random Prompt from his adoring audience, who want to see certain actions performed. These Prompts last for 8 second(s).
If either Champion does what the audience wants, the Prompt is completed and Mojo gains 1 million Followers.
If a Prompt expires without being completed, the Prompt is failed and Mojo loses 5 million Follower(s).
When a Prompt is completed, Mojo activates his Anti-Life Field for 7 second(s).
Mojo receives a new Prompt when his Anti-Life Field expires or a Prompt is failed.
Prompts are paused during any Special Attack.
Prompts are unaffected by Ability Accuracy.

abilitySections.title: Anti-Life Field - Passive
content: The Opponent is inflicted with a 90% Atrophy Passive for the duration of the Field, unaffected by Ability Accuracy.
Any time a Buff is Nullified or Expires off the Opponent, Mojo Passively Degenerates them for [7,829.36] Damage over 6 second(s).
The Anti-Life Field is paused during any Special Attack.

abilitySections.title: Audience Adoration
content: Mojo gains additional Passive abilities based on how many Followers he has.
1 million: Any time a Buff expires or is Nullified off the Opponent, Mojo heals for 3% of his Missing Health over 2 second(s). This does not stack.
3 million: When a Prompt is completed, Mojo gains up to 50% of a Bar of Power based on how many Followers he has.
5 million: Completing a Prompt has a 100% chance to place a Hater Buff on the Opponent for 20 second(s). Basic Attacks have a 15% chance to place one. Haters have no effect.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: If a Prompt is active, Mojo replaces it with a new Prompt. This does not affect his Followers.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: 100% chance on the first hit to Nullify one Buff from the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: If the Anti-Life Field is not active, trigger its Degeneration.
If the Anti-Life Field is active, trigger its Degeneration for every million Followers Mojo has, up to 5 million.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Complete the current Prompt.
Trigger the Anti-Life Field Degeneration for every million Followers Mojo has, up to 5 million.

abilitySections.title: Possible Audience Prompts
content: Activate a Special Attack
Charge a Heavy Attack
Dash backwards
Block a Hit
Use Dexterity to avoid a Hit
Hold Block for 1.5 second(s)
Inflict a Stun
When any Buff expires or is Nullified
Back into the corner
Idle for 1 second(s)
Punish a Special Attack, by striking the Opponent while they're recovering from the Attack
Knock down a Champion
